title: clypeola jonthlaspi var. hispida
intro: Clypeola jonthlaspi var. hispida, commonly known as shepherd's purse, is a biennial or annual plant belonging to the mustard family (Brassicaceae). The plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing, due to its therapeutic actions such as antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and hemostatic properties. The bioactive constituents of shepherd's purse include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties. As a folk remedy, shepherd's purse has been used to treat various conditions, including diarrhea, bleeding, and respiratory issues.
